name: saddle
description: Work on your own WordPress site safely: connect Saddle, the self-hosted WordPress MCP server, and follow its protocol for building pages, editing content, SEO, updates and undo. Nothing goes through a third party.

mcp_url.title: Your site's Saddle address
mcp_url.description: The address from Saddle → Apps in your WordPress admin, for example https://example.com/wp-json/saddle/v1/mcp. Claude Code opens your site's approval screen the first time you use it.
